intro: Teronis' Journal is a field notebook recovered from the remains of a night elf scout in Ashenvale. Found alongside the slain investigator, it documents his search for a mysterious gem and serves as vital evidence for the Sentinels in Astranaar.

p: A longtime friend of Raene Wolfrunner aiding the Sentinels, Teronis ventured into the wilds of Ashenvale seeking a gem for a rod he believed could slow the furbolg attacks on his people. His mission ended abruptly when he fell in the field, surrounded by aggressive creatures near the shore. Recovered from his personal effects, this journal remains in remarkably good condition despite the violence of his demise. It outlines his findings regarding a radiant gem that once formed part of that rod, providing Astranaar's defenders with the vital trail needed to see his unfinished mission through.
